items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Vic, your old man, Gabby Glennie, all that bunch.

ctx.x: Sure, you couldn't master your violin if you couldn't play, you could use the bow. You know, them young fellas now don't use no bow. Jimmy Johnson. Uh-huh. Yeah, another fine bass player. You know, Vic, your old man, Gabby Glennie, all that bunch. You know, the bow, yes, indeed. It's nice to meet you. Glad to meet you. Yeah, all them guys. Yeah.
Well, what did you call it in the old days, when the drummer would take, say, two bars or four bars, and then the band would come back for four bars?
